decisions.decision: Build a personal-first physical agent inbox for the connected LILYGO T-Keyboard S3 Pro
decisions.rationale: The immediate need is glanceable awareness of agents requiring attention and one-key switching

decisions.decision: Mirror the installed herdr-agent-inbox ordering exactly
decisions.rationale: Herdr already provides the user's preferred blocked, unseen, working, idle, and settled semantics

decisions.decision: Use one to three dynamic display keys for inbox agents and reserve the fourth for Codex limits
decisions.rationale: This fits the four-key hardware while prioritizing the inbox and retaining useful ambient capacity data

decisions.decision: An agent key only focuses the corresponding herdr agent
decisions.rationale: Deeper interaction stays inside the agent; selection must not silently settle or mutate inbox state

decisions.decision: Keep the encoder secondary and defer general macros
decisions.rationale: The encoder requires multiple uncomfortable interactions and macros would dilute the initial inbox loop

decisions.decision: Research transport with a preference for USB
decisions.rationale: The device already needs wired power, but the supported and reliable data path has not yet been proven

decisions.decision: Require physical end-to-end operation for v1
decisions.rationale: The real connected device, herdr focus action, live inbox data, and Codex limits must work together

decisions.decision: Use project-specific Sol and Luna routing
decisions.rationale: Sol provides judgment for planning and review; cheaper Luna performs guided research and execution
